title: Waiting list

hero.f_sub: Focus with your friends during exam weeks, and get rewarded for what you had to do anyway.
hero.g: Get rewarded for your focus hours.
hero.g_sub: Put your phone down and focus with your squad during exam weeks.
hero.g_no_money: No money. Points for partner rewards.

block1: A squad of three to six friends. You see who is in, and they see you. Together you build a streak.
block2_title: It only counts while Rewarded stays on your screen.
block2: On your phone: screen down on the table, Rewarded stays on. If you open another app, your session stops and we tell you why. On your laptop: Rewarded open in a tab. There we cannot see what your phone does, so put it away yourself.
block2_note: Focus time that counts = Rewarded was visible and active on your screen, nothing more.
block3: For focus time that counts you get points. You exchange them for rewards from a catalogue that partners pay for in advance. Which rewards the pilot has, we announce once the budget is fixed. You can redeem after five hours of focus, and there is a weekly cap. Points are not money and cannot be turned into money.
cta: Sign up with at least two friends or through your study association. The first group starts in December, just before the exams.
group_banner: A friend shared this link. Sign up, and you get in together.
consent: I want emails about the pilot and the launch, and I read the privacy statement.
small: 16+. We email you about the pilot and the launch, and ask for feedback once. You can unsubscribe any time.
consent_needed: Tick the box to sign up.
invalid_email: This email address is not right. Check it.
failed: That did not work. Try again.
done_title: You are on the waiting list.
done_squad: Check your mail: it has your group link. Share it with two or more friends, and you get in together.
done_solo: Check your mail for the confirmation. Those who come with friends go first; your group link is in the same email.
